public_rationale: The published MMLU scores support the historical comparison: GPT-2 scored 32.4%, GPT-3 43.9%, GPT-4 86.4%, and April 2024 Turbo 86.5–86.7%. The successive reported gains were 11.5, 42.5 and 0.1–0.3 percentage points. The last increase was substantially smaller. This supports Marcus's deliberately tentative observation. Evaluation methods differed, so the figures do not establish a controlled capability trend or prove diminishing returns to training resources.
limitations: GPT-2 was fine-tuned, GPT-3 and GPT-4 used few-shot evaluation, and the Turbo results used zero-shot chain-of-thought prompting.
MMLU percentage accuracy has an upper bound; smaller absolute gains alone do not establish a general limit on progress.
The counterevidence concerns comparability and the broader inference, rather than reversing the reported score pattern.
